agent_explanation: Two-body close pericenter passage is under-resolved by fixed-dt leapfrog with capped adaptive substeps. Separation shrinks 1.24 (step0) -> 0.83 (step30) -> 0.25 (step33) -> 0.16 (step34) while speeds grow 2 -> 13.4, with substeps only rising 1->16. Energy drifts monotonically from -244.6 at step30 to -283.2 at step34 (34.5 change vs 33.1 allowed), while momentum stays conserved, indicating integration truncation error at pericenter, not a force bug. Halving dt removes the violation.
